# DS1 FPS Unlock (Remastered)

By zofrea1, MIT licensed; see LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/zofrea1/DS1-FPS-Unlock-PTDE-Remastered
Tag: v1.8.0-REMASTERED-DX11, commit 1bdf4e588574b4c63c874181661656cc5cbc6ea8.

Q-Souls links the timing/physics sources into its runtime, preserving Steam startup.
The proxy DLL and diagnostics hotkeys are not enabled. Remastered baseline movement,
camera and HUD speeds are retained. patches.cpp keeps the pacer clock continuous
when the in-game FPS cap changes. No original game files are included.
